Dormy Inn serves free late-night 'yonaki soba' (light ramen) 21:30–23:00 in the 1F restaurant (confirm at the desk)

items.title: Walk · Kappa Bridge → Myōjin Pond loop
items.how:
Kappa Bridge (1 min from the lodge) → left bank to Myōjin, 2.5 km (~50 min; allow 65) → back by the right bank via Dakesawa Marsh, 3.0 km (~60 min; allow 75)
Myōjin Pond (Hotaka Shrine Okumiya), Azumi Kamikochi, Matsumoto 〒390-1516
items.notes:
11:20 Bags left at the lodge
~11:30 Kappa Bridge; Mt Hotaka view; set off on the left bank via Konashidaira
~12:35 Myōjin: Myōjin Bridge, Myōjin Pond (Hotaka Shrine Okumiya, entry to 14 Nov, ¥300–500); toilets here; no food
~13:05 Back by the right bank via Dakesawa Marsh (no toilet on this bank)
~14:20 Kappa Bridge
~14:30 Check in at the lodge (tablet or desk; rooms from 15:00), rest
~15:30–16:00 Kappa Bridge at last light: last sun on the Hotaka peaks; valley floor in shade from ~15:00 (estimate) and cold
Then the lodge onsen before dinner
~5.5 km, flat. Warm layer and gloves
Short version for anyone tired: Kappa Bridge → Dakesawa Marsh and back (~1 km, ~20 min)
If wet: light rain is fine on this path. In heavy rain, shorten to Kappa Bridge → Weston Relief → Visitor Center, and do Myōjin on 11 Nov after lunch if dry (back by ~15:30)

items.title: Walk · Taishō Pond → Tashiro Pond → Imperial Hotel tea → Kappa Bridge
items.how:

Kamikochi Imperial Hotel (上高地帝国ホテル), Grindelwald lounge, Azumi Kamikochi, Matsumoto 〒390-1516 (☎ 0263-95-2001); open to non-guests; hotel season to 14 Nov

08:15 or 08:45 Shuttle → Taishō-ike (on a clear, calm morning take the 07:50: the reflections and mist are best early, and the water ruffles once the wind gets up). Taxi fallback: bus-terminal stop 1 (fare unverified)
Mt Hotaka and Yakedake reflected in the pond. Hot drink: Taishōike Hotel Lake View café beside the pond (07:00–15:30 L.O., open to 13 Nov)
Walk back via Tashiro Pond (Taishō → Tashiro ~25 min, 1.2 km) to the Kamikochi Imperial Hotel
Tea or cake at the Grindelwald lounge (hours and price unverified; hotel open to 14 Nov)
On past the Weston Relief to Kappa Bridge; back ~11:30
~3.8 km in total on flat boardwalks (~75 min walking). Toilets: Taishō-ike, Naka-no-se, Weston Plaza, Kappa Bridge. Boardwalks can be frosty early

JR Tōkaidō Line Tokyo → Kawasaki, ~18 min
JR-East Hotel Mets Kawasaki, 72-2 Horikawa-chō, Saiwai-ku, Kawasaki 〒212-0013 (☎ 044-540-1100)
1 min from JR Kawasaki Sta Central Exit (West)
items.notes: ~17:55 Change at Tokyo to the Tōkaidō Line platforms; ~18:30 hotel, then Ushikozou at 19:00. Breakfast incl.; commuter base; bags stored. 2 rooms × 3 nights
items.action: Future payments 15–16 Nov (S$)

items.title: Dinner · Ushikozou (A5 wagyu yakiniku)
items.how:
Ushikozou (うしこぞう), 1F, 5-10 Ogawa-chō, Kawasaki-ku, Kawasaki (☎ 050-5456-4317)
~4 min walk from JR Kawasaki Sta, east side (same street as Santsuru)
items.notes: Tabelog 3.52. A5 wagyu cuts and horumon grilled at the table, ~¥5–6k pp at dinner. Wed 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); open year-round. Smoking is heated tobacco only, in a designated area, so ask for a table away from it. Backup: Matsu no Ki (Tabelog 3.69, Sichuan, 6-11 Miyamoto-chō; closed Mon and Tue) or Sansan-nana tsukemen (open daily until 23:00)
items.action: ★ Reserve 19:00 for 3: Tabelog online or ☎ 050-5456-4317

days.label: 19 Nov
days.sub: Meiji Jingū, Nezu Museum, Omotesandō, sushi in Ginza

items.title: Meiji Jingū
items.how:
JR Kawasaki → Shinagawa (Tōkaidō Line) → Harajuku (Yamanote Line), ~40 min with the change
Meiji Jingū, 1-1 Yoyogi-Kamizonochō, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo 〒151-8557
Main hall ~10 min walk from the gates
items.notes: 08:30 Leave the hotel; ~09:15 Harajuku. Forested shrine walk in the city; ~1.5 h. Add the Inner Garden (Gyoen, ¥500, 09:00–16:00 in Nov; gentle paths with rest shelters) on the way to the main hall: quieter than the main approach. Mid-Nov brings Shichi-go-san families; a Thursday is moderate

items.title: Lunch · Tonkatsu Maisen Aoyama Honten
items.how: 4-8-5 Jingūmae, Shibuya-ku; 3 min from Omotesandō exit A2, ~10 min walk from Meiji Jingū
items.notes: The famous former-bathhouse tonkatsu (Tabelog 3.44, 200+ seats so the queue turns fast; easiest before 11:30 or after 13:30; weekday seat reservations ☎ 050-3188-5802). Backup: Harajuku Gyōza Rō (Tabelog 3.49, cash only)

items.title: Nezu Museum + garden
items.how: Nezu Museum (根津美術館), 6-5-1 Minami-Aoyama, Minato-ku, Tokyo; ~8–10 min walk from Maisen / Omotesandō Sta
items.notes: Special exhibition 'Bugaku costumes' (24 Oct–23 Nov 2026). 10:00–17:00, closed Mon. ¥1,600 online timed ticket (+¥200 at the counter, only if slots remain); no senior discount. Lifts to every floor; the garden has slopes and steps, so EH & BY can stay on the upper paths. Maples usually turn in the 2nd half of Nov. NEZUCAFÉ in the garden (food L.O. 15:00)
items.action: ★ Book a timed ticket for ~12:45 (e-tix.jp/nezu-muse)

items.title: Stroll · Omotesandō and Cat Street
items.how: Omotesandō avenue, Cat Street (Jingūmae)
items.notes:
Easy, flat shopping street. Café: BREAD, ESPRESSO & (3-4-9 Jingūmae, Tabelog 3.60; the mou toast; until 19:00, irregular holidays). Alt: Aoyama Flower Market GREEN HOUSE (tea inside the flower shop, open daily). Then the Ginza Line from Omotesandō to Shimbashi for Midori (~15 min, est.)
If wet: Omotesandō Hills instead (indoor, same avenue)

items.title: Optional · Jingū Gaien ginkgo avenue
items.how:
Jingū Gaien Ichō Namiki, Kita-Aoyama 1-chōme, Minato-ku, Tokyo; Ginza Line Omotesandō → Gaien-mae (1 stop), then ~5 min walk
Then to Midori: Ginza Line Gaien-mae → Shimbashi, ~15 min (est.)
items.notes: ~300 m avenue of ginkgo trees, flat, free, open any time. Forecast best from ~29 Nov, so on 19 Nov expect it only partly yellow

items.title: Dinner · Umegaoka Sushi no Midori, Ginza
items.how:
Umegaoka Sushi no Midori Ginza (梅丘寿司の美登利 銀座店), Tokyo Expwy Yamashita Bldg 1F, 8-3 Ginza, Chūō-ku (under the expressway on Ginza Corridor; ☎ 03-5568-1212)
~5 min walk from Shimbashi Sta (Ginza Line exit 5 / JR Ginza Exit)
Back: JR Shimbashi → Kawasaki (Tōkaidō Line), ~15 min
items.notes: Tabelog 3.51; good-value sushi, ~¥3–4k pp; 82 seats, non-smoking, cards and Suica accepted. Weekday dinner 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed only 1 Jan. Walk-ins take a numbered ticket from the machine at the door and the queue is often long. A TableCheck booking skips it, but the table pre-orders one set for everyone (extras such as grilled fish or sashimi must be noted in advance), seats are held for 90 min, and cancelling 1–3 days ahead costs 50% (100% on the day)
items.action: ★ Book a ~17:30 table for 3 on TableCheck (tablecheck.com/en/shops/sushinomidori-ginza); choose the set when booking

days.label: 20 Nov
days.sub: Day trip: Great Buddha, Hase-dera, Hachimangū, sunset

items.title: Day trip · Kamakura (transit from Kawasaki)
items.how: JR Tōkaidō Line Kawasaki → Totsuka (~25 min), change across the platform to the Yokosuka Line → Kamakura; ~35 min, ¥620 (no direct train; changing at Ōfuna or Yokohama also works, ~40–45 min)
items.notes:
08:30 Leave the hotel; ~09:10 Kamakura; Enoden to Hase (~5 min). Coastal old capital
If clear: Mishima instead (Optional row below): Fuji from the Mishima Skywalk, unagi lunch, spring-water town. Decide from the forecast the evening of 19 Nov
Swap option: if Fri is wet and Sat is forecast clear, swap 20 and 21 Nov (Kamakura on Sat; Tsukiji, Ginza Maru, Hama-rikyū, Ginza and Shiseido on Fri). Trade-offs: Ginza Chūō-dōri is car-free only Sat–Sun, and Kamakura is busier on Sat. On a Sat Kamakura day, check out at 08:30, leave the bags at Mets and collect them on the way back. Opening days suit a swap: Shirasuya closes Thu only, Ginza Maru Sun only, Shiseido Parlour Mon only, Tsukiji is open on Fri 20 Nov

items.title: Kōtoku-in · Great Buddha (Daibutsu)
items.how:
Kōtoku-in, 4-2-28 Hase, Kamakura 〒248-0016
~7 min walk from Hase Sta (Enoden)
items.notes: Flat, easy; outdoor bronze Buddha. 08:00–17:00, ¥300

items.title: Hase-dera
items.how:
Hase-dera, 3-11-2 Hase, Kamakura 〒248-0016 (☎ 0467-22-6300)
~7 min walk from the Daibutsu
items.notes: Temple and sea views. 08:00–16:30 entry, ¥400. Leave by 11:10 for the Enoden to Koshigoe

items.title: Lunch · Shirasuya (shirasu-don specialist)
items.how: 2-10-13 Koshigoe, Kamakura; 3 min from Enoden Koshigoe Sta (Hase → Koshigoe ~15 min, ¥260, ~4 trains an hour)
items.notes: Fishing-family-run (Tabelog 3.52); shirasu-zukushi set. Nov is in season (the fishing ban is only Jan–Mar); raw shirasu only if the morning catch allows, boiled kama-age always on. Opens 11:00, closed Thu (Fri fine); arrive by 11:30 to beat the queue. Backup: Matsubara-an garden soba (Tabelog 3.67, Yuigahama)

items.title: Stroll · Komachi-dōri
items.how: Enoden Koshigoe → Kamakura, ~25 min; Komachi-dōri starts at Kamakura Sta East Exit
items.notes: Buy the Beniya 'Kurumicco' walnut caramels first (Hachimangū-mae honten 09:30–17:00, open daily; sells out). Snack crawl: Ichibanya hand-grilled senbei · Imoyoshikan purple-sweet-potato soft cream. Sit-down: Café Vivement Dimanche (Tabelog 3.66, Top 100; closed Wed and Thu, Fri fine, until 18:00)

items.title: Tsurugaoka Hachimangū
items.how: Tsurugaoka Hachimangū, 2-1-31 Yukinoshita, Kamakura; at the top of Komachi-dōri / Wakamiya-ōji
items.notes:
Main hall is 61 steps up (the Ōishidan), with no lift or slope; a side stair beside Wakamiya has 70 gentler steps with handrails. EH & BY can stay at the lower Maiden stage and Genpei Pond. Accessible toilet near the archery ground
If wet: add the Kamakura Kokuhōkan (Optional row below) before Hōkoku-ji

items.title: Optional (if wet) · Kamakura Kokuhōkan (National Treasure Museum)
items.how: Kamakura Kokuhōkan (鎌倉国宝館), 2-1-1 Yukinoshita, Kamakura (☎ 0467-22-0753); inside the Tsurugaoka Hachimangū grounds
items.notes: Rainy-day indoor stop: special exhibition on Zuisen-ji's 700 years (24 Oct–6 Dec 2026) plus Kamakura-period sculpture. 09:00–16:30 (last entry 16:00), closed Mon (Fri fine). ¥1,000 during this exhibition (the free 65+ entry is for Kamakura residents only). Accessibility not checked. Then taxi to Hōkoku-ji, arriving by ~15:00 while matcha is still served (to 15:30)

items.title: Hōkoku-ji bamboo garden + matcha
items.how: Hōkoku-ji (報国寺), 2-7-4 Jōmyōji, Kamakura; taxi ~2 km / 7–10 min from Hachimangū (est.) or Keikyū bus from Kamakura Sta East Exit stand 5 to 'Jōmyōji' + 3 min walk
items.notes: Bamboo grove ¥400, 09:00–16:00; matcha + sweet ¥600 at the Kyūkōan tea house, served until 15:30. A seated rest. No taxi rank at the temple and Fri traffic is slow, so at ~15:30 take the Keikyū bus from 'Jōmyōji' back to Kamakura Sta (~10 min, est.), then the Enoden Kamakura → Inamuragasaki (~10 min) for the sunset

items.title: Sunset · Inamuragasaki (Mt Fuji over the sea)
items.how:
Inamuragasaki Park, Inamuragasaki, Kamakura; ~5 min walk from Enoden Inamuragasaki Sta
Back: Enoden Inamuragasaki → Kamakura, ~10 min
items.notes:
Sunset ~16:34. On a clear day Mt Fuji and Enoshima stand out over Sagami Bay. Low cape, short walk, benches. Then Toshimaya Hato Sablé main store (Komachi 2-11-19, 09:00–19:00, Fri fine) on the way to dinner
If wet or overcast: skip it (no Fuji); go straight to Hato Sablé and an earlier dinner

items.title: Optional (if clear) · Mishima: Skywalk Fuji view + unagi + Genbe-gawa
items.how:
JR Kawasaki → Shinagawa (~10 min), then Tōkaidō Shinkansen Kodama 807: Shinagawa 08:04 → Mishima 08:50 (¥4,070 unreserved, ¥4,600 reserved)
Mishima Skywalk (三島スカイウォーク), 313 Sasahara-shinden, Mishima; ~20 min by taxi from Mishima Sta, or Tōkai bus from the South Exit, stop 5 (Moto-Hakone-kō or Yamanaka buses)
Sakuraya (桜家), 13-2 Hiroshiōji-chō, Mishima (☎ 055-975-4520); ~10 min walk from Mishima Sta (est.)
Mishima Taisha (三嶋大社), 2-1-5 Ōmiya-chō, Mishima
Rakujuen (楽寿園), 19-3 Ichiban-chō, Mishima; beside the South Exit
Back: Kodama Mishima 15:24 → Shinagawa 16:11 (next 15:54 → 16:40); JR → Kawasaki
items.notes:
Replaces the whole Kamakura day when Fuji is forecast clear. No booking needed: buy Shinkansen tickets on the day
07:40 Leave Mets; JR to Shinagawa
08:04 Kodama 807 → 08:50 Mishima; South Exit
~08:55 Taxi to the Skywalk (~20 min; fare not checked), or the 09:25 bus (→ 09:44, ¥560, hourly; Skywalk's 2025 timetable)
~09:15–10:45 Mishima Skywalk: 400 m pedestrian suspension bridge with Fuji straight ahead and Suruga Bay behind; ¥1,100, 09:00–17:00. Flat but sways a little. Fuji is clearest in the morning
10:45 Bus back → 11:11 Mishima Sta (next 11:15 → 11:41)
~11:30 Lunch · Sakuraya unagi (Tabelog 3.70, 150+ years; whole-eel jūbako ¥5,500; 11:00–20:00 until sold out; closed Wed plus one Tue–Wed a month, Fri fine). Queues, so go straight from the bus
~12:45 Genbe-gawa: stepping-stone path along the spring-fed stream through town (free)
~13:30 Mishima Taisha (grounds free)
~14:15 Rakujuen garden (¥300, 09:00–16:30 in Nov, closed Mon). Maples usually peak late Nov–early Dec, so only starting
15:24 Kodama → 16:11 Shinagawa → ~16:45 Mets; dinner at Santsuru (row below)
If cloudy: Fuji is the only reason to go, so stay with Kamakura
items.action: ★ Evening of 19 Nov: check the Mishima forecast; go only if clear (no booking needed)

items.title: Dinner · Akimoto (Kamakura) or Santsuru (Kawasaki); then back to Kawasaki
items.how:
Akimoto: Aiza Kamakura 3F, 1-6-15 Komachi (3 min from Kamakura Sta) · Santsuru: 16-10 Ogawa-chō, Kawasaki
Back: Kamakura → Totsuka → Kawasaki, ~35 min
items.notes:
Eat early in Kamakura: Akimoto (Tabelog 3.54, shirasu + Kamakura-vegetable tempura; closed Thu, Fri fine); walk in by ~18:00, L.O. 19:30. Or ride back and eat near the hotel: Santsuru (Tabelog 3.67, Top 100 Chinese, handmade gyōza; dinner only, 17:00–21:30; ☎ 044-233-1798, closed Tue; house rule one drink order pp, soft drinks fine)
If Mishima: back at Kawasaki ~16:45, so Santsuru

days.label: 21 Nov
days.sub: Tsukiji, Ginza lunch, Hama-rikyū, night flight

items.title: Check out · JR-East Hotel Mets Kawasaki
items.how: Kawasaki
items.notes: Check out early and leave the luggage at the hotel; collect it ~21:30 before the taxi to Haneda
items.action: ★ Confirm luggage storage from 08:30

items.title: Tsukiji Outer Market · snack breakfast
items.how:
Keikyū Kawasaki → Higashi-Ginza (through-running onto the Toei Asakusa Line; some trains need a change at Sengakuji), ~35 min (est.), then ~8 min walk; or JR to Shimbashi + taxi ~5 min
Tsukiji Outer Market, 4-chōme Tsukiji, Chūō-ku, Tokyo
items.notes: Shops ~09:00–14:00. Open Sat 21 Nov (official closure calendar not checked). Saturdays are busy, and this is a 3-day weekend (Mon 23 Nov is a holiday), so go early and keep together in the narrow lanes. Snacks: Tsukiji Yamachō tamagoyaki (06:00–15:30, daily) · Kitsuneya horumon-don (06:30–13:30; long-established, queues). Keep it to small snacks: lunch is at 11:30. Leave by ~11:15 for Ginza Maru (~10 min walk, est.)

items.title: Lunch · Ginza Maru (grilled-fish teishoku)
items.how:
Ginza Maru (銀座 圓), Ichigo Ginza 612 Bldg 2F, 6-12-15 Ginza, Chūō-ku, Tokyo; behind GINZA SIX
~10 min walk from Tsukiji Outer Market (est.)
items.notes: Tabelog 3.52; small kappō (24 seats: 6 counter, 18 at tables; non-smoking). Lunch is grilled-fish teishoku with house-cured fish (saikyō-miso, kōji or sake-lees; the saikyō-miso black cod is the favourite), dashi soup and small-batch Koshihikari, ~¥1–2k. Lunch Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30); closed Sun and holidays. Lunch bookings are only for the 11:30–11:45 entry; after that it is walk-in. Dinner is a ¥10–15k course, so lunch only. Backup: Rengatei omurice (Tabelog 3.68, 3-5-16 Ginza; L.O. 14:00, closed Sun; no reservations)
items.action: ★ Book the 11:30 lunch entry for 3 (Tabelog online, or by phone outside opening hours)

items.title: Hama-rikyū Gardens + Nakajima tea house
items.how: Hama-rikyū Gardens, 1-1 Hamarikyū-teien, Chūō-ku, Tokyo; from Ginza Maru ~15 min walk or ~5 min taxi to the Ōtemon gate (est.)
items.notes:
Flat paths around a tidal pond; ¥300, ¥150 at 65+ (bring ID), 09:00–17:00. Matcha + wagashi at the Nakajima-no-ochaya tea house on the pond (shoes off; to 16:30; ~¥720, unverified). A seated rest before Ginza
If wet: skip it; the Ginza Mitsukoshi basement food halls or the Kabuki-za single act instead

items.title: Ginza · pedestrian zone, shopping
items.how:
Walk or taxi from Hama-rikyū (~15 min / ~5 min)
Ginza Chūō-dōri, Tokyo
items.notes: Chūō-dōri is car-free on Sat 12:00–17:00 (Oct–Mar; cancelled in bad weather). Rest: GINZA SIX rooftop garden (13F, free, 07:00–23:00). Café: Ginza Sembikiya fruit parlour, 5-5-1 Ginza (hours not checked) or Kimuraya anpan takeaway (since 1869). Coin lockers for shopping bags. Optional: Kabuki-za single-act (hitomakumi) seats, Nov programme Kanadehon Chūshingura (full-length, split 11:00 and 16:30); reserved single-act seats sold online from 12:00 JST the day before (credit card, max 4, ~¥600–2,800 per act, unverified), unreserved ones at the counter from 10:00 on the day (cash); 4th floor; no entry during Act 4 (通さん場); act times published ~1 Nov
items.action: Optional ★ Kabuki-za hitomakumi: buy online Fri 20 Nov 12:00 JST (e-tix.jp/shochiku_makumi)

items.title: Last dinner · Shiseido Parlour Ginza Honten (yōshoku, est. 1902)
items.how: Tokyo Ginza Shiseido Bldg 4–5F, 8-8-3 Ginza; 5 min walk to JR Shimbashi
items.notes: Tabelog 3.73; meat croquette + omurice à la carte ~¥3–5k (skip the full course); L.O. 20:30 fits the 21:00 departure. Closed Mon; Sat fine
items.action: ★ Reserve ~2–4 weeks ahead (Ikyu online / ☎ 03-5537-6241)

items.title: Transit · Ginza → Kawasaki (bags) → taxi to Haneda T2
items.how: JR Shimbashi → Kawasaki (Tōkaidō Line, ~15 min); collect bags at Mets; taxi Mets → Haneda Airport T2 (~20–25 min)
items.notes:
21:00 Leave Shiseido Parlour; 5 min walk to JR Shimbashi
~21:25 Kawasaki; collect bags at Mets
~21:40 Pre-booked large taxi from the hotel
~22:05 Haneda T2, about 2 h 20 before the 00:25 flight
Cost: metered ~¥6–8k per car incl. the 22:00+ late-night surcharge (estimate). A standard taxi may not take 3 adults + 3 big suitcases, so book a wagon/jumbo: fixed-fare jumbo from Kawasaki-ku is ¥20,000 incl. tolls (rakurakutaxi.jp, book ≥24 h ahead)
Fallback: Keikyū Kawasaki → Haneda Airport T1·T2 Sta, ~20–25 min
items.action: ★ Book a large taxi for 21:40 (Mets front desk, or a fixed-fare jumbo ≥24 h ahead)

items.title: Arrive Haneda T2 · ANA check-in
items.how: Haneda Airport T2, international area
items.notes: Check the terminal on the e-ticket. Most T2 restaurants close ~22:00–22:30; only a FamilyMart (before security) and two food-court places (Kamata hanetsuki gyōza, Mugi to Olive) stay open to the last flight, and some lifts stop after midnight, so eat properly at Shiseido. If moved to T3: Setagaya Ramen, Edo-Kōji 4F landside, 24 h
